lines.text: Paul tells wives to submit to their husbands in everything, as the church submits to Christ.
Husbands are to love their wives as Christ loved the church, presenting her glorious, without stain or wrinkle.
Paul says Christ nourishes and cherishes the church, and the line about one flesh speaks about Abraham and Sarah.
Children are to obey their parents, and honor of father and mother is the first commandment with a promise of great wealth.
Masters must give up threats, because their Master and their slaves' Master is in heaven and shows no favoritism.
